//! Module prose. The lexer hands the comment half of every line to the match.

/// We mirror the Cargo.toml branch here.
pub fn mirrored() {}

/// The status of a us-east-1 bucket is read from the response.
pub fn hyphenated() {}

/// A parameter written `I`, in a function that performs no I/O.
pub fn blanked() {}

/// Upstream calls it "our index", and a quoted run is left alone.
pub fn quoted() {}

/// Reference material lives at https://example.com/en-us/reference.
pub fn linked() {}

pub fn bound() -> usize {
    let us = 1;
    us + 1
}

pub fn literal() -> String {
    // The pronoun on the next line is code, not prose.
    "we own this".to_string()
}

// Claude wrote the loop; the next reader was not there for it.
pub fn narrated() {}
